title: Declarative 2D-Interaction Spec (engine #5)
description: Declarative spec for the 2D-interaction engine (engine #5, ledger §E / F5b). MVP-critical (AC-101, AC-102, ~25-30 courses). A spec is a `background` (image R2 key or schematic) plus a list of `items`, each of one kind: drag-label, label, match, sort, or hotspot. Every item carries an answer key and per-item scoring, per-item feedback ('why that's wrong'), a §5.4 dimension tag and an optional safety_flag (fail-safe/fail-locked items are safety-adjacent → >=90% per ledger §C). engine_kind is pinned to 'interaction_2d' (academy.sim_kind).

$schema.description: Optional editor/CI hint pointing at this schema's $id.

envelope.description: Shared sim envelope. engine_kind MUST be 'interaction_2d'.

background.description: The shared canvas most items render over (the diagram/schematic). Optional for pure match/sort items.

r2_key.description: R2 image key, OR omit and set schematic_id for a vector schematic (the high-contrast picture-book fallback is first-class).

schematic_id.description: Id of a built-in vector schematic (the 2D picture-book primitive).

items.description: The interactive items. Each is independently scored; the envelope scoring hook aggregates and applies the safety subset bar.

region.title: region / target
region.description: A rectangular or polygonal area on the background, used as a drop target or hotspot. Coordinates are in background units.

scoring.title: per-item scoring
scoring.description: Per-item score weight + the §5.4 mapping + the safety flag.

safety_flag.description: True if this item is safety-adjacent (e.g. an AC-102 fail-safe/fail-locked match). Applies the >=90% safety bar (ledger §C) and routes a wrong answer through the veto hook when the sim is safety-gated.

item.title: interaction item
item.description: A single interaction. Discriminated by `kind`: drag-label/label (place a label on a region), match (pair items across columns), sort (order a sequence), hotspot (tap the correct region).

feedback_i18n.description: One-line 'why that's wrong' shown on a wrong answer (instant, specific, diagnostic).

item.$comment: unevaluatedProperties (not additionalProperties) at the item level: it sees the properties evaluated by the matched oneOf branch AND the base props above, so it locks the object down without each branch having to re-declare the base props. This avoids the classic additionalProperties+oneOf collision.

oneOf.title: drag-label / label item
oneOf.description: Place draggable labels onto regions of the background (AC-101 anatomy-of-a-door). answer_key maps each label id to its correct region id.

oneOf.title: match item
oneOf.description: Match items across columns (AC-102 'Spec the Door': credential <-> reader-protocol <-> lock-family <-> fail-state). answer_key pairs left ids to right ids.

oneOf.title: sort / order item
oneOf.description: Order a sequence (AC-101 access-event lifecycle). answer_key is the ordered list of element ids.

answer_key.description: Correct order as a list of element ids.

oneOf.title: hotspot item
oneOf.description: Tap the correct region (e.g. 'tap the side that must always allow free egress'). answer_key lists the correct region id(s).
